stacks.pattern: Grok 4.7 explores cheap → Opus 5.5 plans → Grok/Astra stress-test → Grok writes

stacks.title: Cost ladder

stacks.why: Match model tier to sub-task value. Parallel cheap agents, expensive models only on the critical path.

briefs.title: Partner Network launch + Bot phone integrations + Duet competitor signal
points: SpaceXSI launched the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network (Oct 22): official program for Transformation Partners (enterprise deployment) and Marketplace Partners (plugins/integrations). >130 companies in early access; Forward Deployed Engineer accreditation at 30+ orgs. Named partners include Nvidia, Apollo, Snowflake, Databricks, Bain, Booz Allen, MongoDB, Twilio, Zscaler and others. Aimed at accelerating business adoption of Grok.

Grok Bot phone integrations rolling out (Oct 22–23): Calendar, Reminders, Contacts and more apps on iOS/Android. Musk amplifying as life & business manager / genius employee with real-world examples (medical bills, Amazon returns, appointments, family schedules, worksheets, trips, net worth pages, tire rotations). Continues high-visibility demos post-0.71.2.

@AlexFinn: Continues reporting Grok Bot autonomous business success ($1,800, ~100k visitors, 200k+ page views, 3k subscribers). Early access to Claude Duet (Anthropic research preview of proactive agent, built on Opus 5.5): excellent multitasking (one thread auto-spins tasks), coding/PRs, proactivity, human conversational feel. Calls Grok Bot #1 currently but Duet has a shot; emphasizes personal agent harness race (access to emails/calendars/finances/data) as more important than pure model race.

Frontier map stable: Claude Opus 5.5 still leads AA Intelligence Index at 57.6 (max). Sonnet 5.5 56, Fable 5.1 53.4, GPT-6 Astra 52.7, Gemini 4 Argon 52.6, GPT-6.1 Sol 51.8. Grok 4.7 remains ~46.4 at $2/$6 — value mid-tier, not composite peak. No new named flagships shipped. Voice 3.0 unchanged (#1 AA Speech-to-Speech at 86.9).

Roadmap clock still Sep 24: cautiously optimistic of Fable/GPT-6 level model in 2–3 months (late Nov–Dec). Grok 4.8 referenced for Bot speed. SpaceXSI branding stable. X Subscription (unified) ongoing.
briefs.assumption: Partner Network is first-party announcement; customer outcomes, revenue impact, and FDE efficacy unmeasured independently. Bot phone integrations and amplified user demos are product/Musk signals; reliability, error rates, and full cost (including any routed Opus) remain unbenchmarked at scale. AlexFinn Duet assessment is early research-preview practitioner signal (US Pro/Max waitlist); not a controlled comparison. AA scores consistent with prior independent trackers.

briefs.title: Grok Bot 0.71.2 polish + autonomous workflow signals
points: Grok Bot 0.71.2 (shipped ~Oct 14, highlighted Oct 20): larger attachments (files to 250 MB, videos to 1 GB, up to 20 files per message), smarter notifications, forms arrive pre-filled, email aliases for tagged routing, improved chat cards/speed/draft edits/X DMs/connectors/voice calls. Musk amplified a full walkthrough video and called it a big update.

Frontier unchanged: Claude Opus 5.5 still leads AA Intelligence Index at 57.6 (max). Sonnet 5.5 56, Fable 5.1 53.4, GPT-6 Astra 52.7, Gemini 4 Argon 52.6, GPT-6.1 Sol 51.8. Grok 4.7 remains ~46.4 at $2/$6 — value mid-tier, not composite peak. No new named flagships shipped.

@AlexFinn (Oct 20): Autonomous Grok Bot business now at $1,800, ~100k visitors, 200k+ page views, 3k newsletter subscribers. Continues sharing the simple process (audience challenge → Bot builds/maintains site, SEO, newsletter via plugins). Hundreds of others report first online dollars from the free template.

Musk continues framing Bot as “incredibly competent employee” and “hire today.” Oct 7 note: most requests simple and will use a lightning-fast Grok 4.8 when available; principle is best speed + intelligence combination. Bot still routes hard tasks to Opus 5.5 and others.
Roadmap clock still Sep 24: cautiously optimistic of Fable/GPT-6 level model in 2–3 months (late Nov–Dec). Grok 4.8 referenced for Bot speed. SpaceXSI branding stable (@SpaceXSI).
X Subscription (unified Premium + Grok + Bot + Cursor) remains live; migration ongoing. Voice 3.0 unchanged (#1 AA Speech-to-Speech at 86.9, $0.08/min).
briefs.assumption: Bot 0.71.2 feature list is from official changelog and Musk-amplified video; real-world reliability, cost (including any routed Opus), and scale of multi-agent flows remain unbenchmarked. AlexFinn revenue and traffic numbers are practitioner self-reports for knowledge-work/autonomous loops, not controlled studies. No independent confirmation of Grok 4.8 training status or release window beyond Musk’s Oct 7 mention.

briefs.title: Grok Voice 3.0 + Bot teams and autonomous workflows
points: Grok Voice 3.0 launched Oct 14: real-time speech-to-speech model, $0.08/min (unchanged from 2.0). Ranks #1 on Artificial Analysis Speech-to-Speech Index at 86.9 (ahead of GPT-Live-1 Astra medium 83.2 and Gemini 3.8 Live 82.6). 0.81s time-to-first-audio; powers Starlink support (majority of calls without HITL) and Tesla/X voice. 28 built-in voices + cloning; tools for web/X/file/MCP.

Grok Bot product refresh: pitches teams of parallel AI teammates (one on project, one on outbound, etc.). Claims cross-Bot learning, preset roles (Sales Outbound, Talent Scout, etc.), macOS desktop alongside Windows. Persistent cloud microVMs continue. Musk continues framing as “incredibly competent employee” with daily ~20 improvements; amplifying shopping, restaurant booking by phone, and other real-world tasks.

@AlexFinn (Oct 15–18): Side Hustle CEO / autonomous CEO Grok Bot templates. One made him $1,800 that week; reports hundreds of others generating first online dollars. Free template: interviews user, pitches ideas, builds and runs microbusiness (plugins, routines, SEO, etc.). Full bootcamp launched. Continues treating Bot as knowledge-work and business agent.

Frontier map stable: Claude Opus 5.5 still leads AA Intelligence Index at 57.6 (max). Sonnet 5.5 56, Fable 5.1 53.4, GPT-6 Astra 52.7, Gemini 4 Argon 52.6 (Oct 13, intro $2/$10), GPT-6.1 Sol 51.8. Grok 4.7 remains ~46.4 at $2/$6 — value mid-tier, not composite leader. Gemini Argon release date updated to Oct 13 in sources.

Roadmap unchanged: Musk Sep 24 “cautiously optimistic” of Fable/GPT-6 level model in 2–3 months (late Nov–Dec). No named successor shipped. SpaceXSI branding continues (handle @SpaceXSI; some residual SpaceXAI references).
X Subscription (unified Premium + Grok + Bot + Cursor) remains live from mid-October; migration ongoing.

briefs.title: The X Subscription + Grok Bot autonomy demos
points: SpaceXSI launched The X Subscription (Oct 12–13): unified tiers bundling X Premium, Grok, Grok Bot, and Cursor. Free / Plus $8 / Premium $30 / Super $100 / Ultra $200. Shared weekly AI usage pool. Premium+ required for latest Grok models and full Bot. Migration from existing plans rolling out; claims more usage-per-dollar than prior separate plans.

Desktop advanced to 0.70.2 (Oct 11): bots can claim own email (approval on send), search X without account connection, pay via X Money/Stripe Link, interactive app cards (Figma/Notion/Canva), and other reliability fixes. Builds on 0.68.1 slide decks and formatted email.

Musk amplifying Grok Bot real-world use (Oct 14): tax review of 266 unlabeled files finding CPA errors leading to amended return; autonomous music video creation routing to Suno/Midjourney/Opus; complex overseas tax filing saving >$1k.

@AlexFinn: Grok Bot autonomously built and maintains microbusiness (agentusecases.ai) generating $1,100 from sponsors, 56k visitors, 40+ PRs, SEO. Provides step-by-step setup (audience challenge → build via Cursor agents → autonomous maintain). Continues treating Bot as knowledge-work agent alongside Opus/Sonnet for coding.
Independent AA Intelligence Index unchanged at top: Opus 5.5 max 57.6, Sonnet 5.5 max 56, Fable 5.1 53.4, Astra 52.7, Argon 52.6, Grok 4.7 ~46.4. Grok remains value option at $2/$6.
Roadmap clock still Sep 24: Fable/GPT-6 level in 2–3 months (late Nov–Dec). No new named ship. Rebrand to SpaceXSI continues (account @SpaceXSI).
